title: Presented at Philips' first Innovation Engineering Impact Showcase
summary: I presented the technical portion of an AI-assisted compliance and traceability story at Philips' first Innovation Engineering Impact Showcase on October 1. The event post lists me among the speakers and thanks the presenters.
what_would_have_happened: The technical work could have remained known mainly to the teams already using it.
the_call: Present the technical story to a broader engineering audience.
what_i_did: Updated the impact slide and presented the technical portion of the story.
what_changed: The post-event message listed me among the speakers and thanked everyone who contributed to the showcase.
